The interaction prompt (screenshot-portrait.png, screenshot-landscape.png): chip sits between top HUD and controls, no overlap with joystick or Jump. Contact Tower in landscape in one continuous run: reached (spawn to lab to tower, 'tower-contact reached prompt: true', panel open and closed, 'hud Energy cells 2/3'); in that run the driver did not reach the Workshop prompt (stopped at -8.3,13.1 vs target -9.8,13.8), a driver navigation miss, not a product defect, since the same driver reached it in portrait; not required by the criterion. Camera clipping in the tower passage after a jump (jport/, nav2.mjs variant, jump screenshots at 4 instants x 2 rounds, portrait): NOT reproduced as avatar-back clipping with the default behind camera (round 0: camera 4.35 m behind, avatar fully rendered). It is not touch-specific: followCamera.ts, cameraProbe.ts, bodyClearance.ts and input.ts are not in the M4 diff, so it is the M3 free-orbit camera behaviour in a 2.4 m wide passage, independent of input device, not an M4 regression. assumptions: Touch evidence is CDP emulation, not a physical phone.
rAF p95 is vsync bound at 16.8 ms; host load was 26 to 45 during all runs.
The Boss-accepted one-line Hud.tsx style insert was verified in the diff and not flagged for ownership.

Findings F1 to F5 below are carried here because the report schema has no findings field: F1 (low, game-dev): .vitest/ is untracked generated json reporter output and needs a .gitignore entry or deletion before commit. F2 (low, game-dev): no hint at the beacon before three cells (design 2.9 deviation accepted), a visitor who reaches the beacon early gets silence. F3 (low, game-dev): in portrait 390x844 the guidance chip appears to abut the bottom edge of the Exit button (Exit rect ends at y 91, chip top about y 89 in the screenshot); verify the stacking offset in ChallengeHud. F4 (low, game-dev, pre-existing M3, defer to M6): in the 2.4 m tower passage the free-orbit camera can end about 2.3 m from the avatar next to the back wall and the jump-pose arm crosses the passage wall; not touch-specific and not an M4 regression (followCamera.ts, cameraProbe.ts, bodyClearance.ts unchanged). F5 (info, mobile-dev): the touch nav driver did not reach the Workshop prompt in landscape (driver navigation miss), landscape workshop is therefore unverified; recommend including it in the M6 deep QA. Pre-existing lint warning in useRealtimeChat.ts is not an M4 finding.
lessonsProposed: Open a Chrome-driving harness copy with the goTo helpers only after the game is started (openGame wait true); a seeded-localStorage probe plus reload is a cheap way to reach late challenge states (beacon ready, completion) without replaying the whole loop.
